studies.primary_metric: paired verifier_reward delta per task; sign test over non-tied pairs; full-pass count delta
secondary: false-intervention count under project enforcement (misfire target: 0; the v5 dotenv symlink kill must not recur)
gate obligation_met and tier1/tier2 counts per arm

studies.decision_rule: This is the campaign's comprehensive merged measurement, not a lever isolation. Any enforced-arm block is adjudicated per-case against the effective-target semantics; a repeat proven-but-wrong block is a stop-and-fix finding regardless of reward delta. Cross-roll noise on dev16 is approximately +/-0.13 mean reward; deltas inside that band are reported as within-noise.

red_lines: Rules, memory text and prompts contain no WorkBuddy-specific content; dev16 is the only iteration surface; sealed48 remains one-shot and unread; generation and evaluation windows do not overlap (RRP-001 lifecycle evidence is synthetic-correction replay, not benchmark traffic).
